en-AU: As a child in Sydney, I repaired bicycles with my father in our shed.
At school, Ms Vale taught me to read maps. I do not remember the year.
Father kept our bicycle tools in a blue tin.
On Saturdays I helped Father repair bicycles.
I am unsure whether I was eight or nine when I first helped him.

The tin was green; I have corrected my earlier description. Father taught me to remove a tyre, find the puncture, and wait for the glue before pressing on a rubber patch. I held a basin while he turned the inner tube through the water. We watched for bubbles. He let me try the patch after showing me once. I sometimes needed another attempt. I remember the basin and the patch, but I cannot remember the brand of glue or the exact year. The work happened in our shed. I have not described its colour or size, and I do not know what the weather was on those days. The maps I learned to read at school were a different memory. I do not know whether those lessons came before or after my first bicycle repair. I remember Father handing me the tin when it was time to put the tools away. I did not keep the tin, and I do not know where it is now.
We used rubber patches and glue to repair punctured inner tubes.
I practised patching tyres beside Father. I sometimes asked him to check a patch.
Yes, that is what I remember.
Father told me that he repaired neighbours’ bicycles before I was born. I did not witness those years.
I recall Father saying that a patch needed time. I cannot promise those were his exact words.
I cannot remember the weather on those Saturdays.
A later caption called the building a garage. I remember it as a shed. I have not supplied a photograph.
zh-CN: 小时候在悉尼，我和父亲在棚屋里一起修自行车。
在学校，威尔老师教我看地图。我不记得是哪一年。
父亲把修自行车的工具放在蓝色铁盒里。
每个星期六，我帮父亲修自行车。
我不确定第一次帮他时是八岁还是九岁。

铁盒是绿色的，我已经纠正了先前的描述。父亲教我拆下轮胎，找到漏气处，等胶水合适后再压上橡胶补片。他把内胎转着放进水里时，我扶着水盆。我们看哪里冒气泡。他示范一次后，让我试着贴补片。有时我需要再试一次。我记得水盆和补片，但记不清胶水的牌子，也记不清确切的年份。我们是在棚屋里修车。我没有描述棚屋的颜色或大小，也记不得那些天的天气。学校里学习看地图是另一段记忆。我不知道那些课是在第一次修自行车之前还是之后。我记得收工具时父亲把铁盒递给我。我没有留下那个铁盒，也不知道它现在在哪里。
我们用橡胶补片和胶水修补扎破的内胎。
我在父亲身边练习补胎，有时请他检查补片。
父亲告诉我，在我出生之前他就替邻居修自行车。我没有亲眼见过那些年。
我记得父亲说过，贴补片需要给它时间。我不能保证这是他的原话。
我记不得那些星期六的天气。
后来的一条说明把那栋建筑称为车库。我记得它是棚屋。我没有提供照片。
